name: Final Authority Cutover Receipt
description: Produce a signed receipt that PGlite is now the sole durable authority for the control plane. Include verification evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Signed receipt document exists with timestamp and author
Receipt includes hash of final PGlite state as verification anchor
Receipt cross-references constraint parity report, idempotency test results, and dual-read log
Receipt is stored in the documentation tree under docs/
Receipt format is machine-readable JSON with human-readable summary
